name: sentry
description: Goblin Sentry: turns IPS alerts into incidents, asks before acting, blocks with temporary blocks only

mode.description: off: nothing; shadow: record what it would do; approve: ask before blocking; auto: rules act, blocks only where you said always

dedup_minutes.description: alerts with the same signature and address within this time are one incident

block_minutes.description: how long a block lasts when no rule says otherwise
